inputs.label: Your disc image of Densha de GO! 2 Kōsoku-hen 3000-bandai (Windows, 2000): the .mdf (with its .mds), the .bin of a .cue, or an .iso. An image inside a .zip or .rar has to be extracted first.

prepare.label: The game files from your disc, checked against the 3000-bandai release

exit_codes.10: The game data isn't there. Set the game up again on its page, with your disc image.
exit_codes.11: This copy isn't the Densha de GO! 2 Kōsoku-hen 3000-bandai disc, or it is damaged. Only that release is supported; a damaged image can be ripped again.
exit_codes.12: The game couldn't start its graphics. It needs Vulkan, DirectX 12 or Metal (or at least OpenGL 3.3): update your graphics driver or system.

settings.label: Language
settings.help: English draws translated text over the original art. 日本語 is the original, untouched. Unset, the game asks on its first start.

settings.label: Full screen
settings.help: Borderless full screen at your monitor's resolution. Alt+Enter or F11 switches it in the game too.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: On: smooth frames at your display's rate. Off: as many frames as the PC can draw. The game itself always runs at the original's 30 ticks a second.

settings.label: HUD layout
settings.help: Original: the 4:3 HUD and menus in the middle of the screen. Wide: the driving HUD at the edges of a widescreen.

settings.label: Draw distance
settings.help: How far ahead the scenery and track are drawn. The original draws 320 m.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: Smooths the edges of the 3D world, wires and fences included. The HUD stays sharp.

actions.label: Saves and settings
actions.help: The rankings, clear marks, controller calibration and config.toml.

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: One log per start, the newest five kept. The newest goes with a bug report.
